results.title: Scaling Agentic AI Factories Through Extreme Co-Design with NVIDIA BlueField
results.summary: NVIDIA technical blog detailing how BlueField-4 DPUs offload, accelerate, and isolate networking, storage, security, and telemetry services inline from host CPUs, including KV-cache management via DOCA Memos for agentic AI factory data paths.

results.title: Communication Offloading on SmartNIC DPUs: A Quantitative Approach
results.summary: Paper exploring asynchronous 'fire-and-forget' inline communication offload to SmartNIC DPUs (NVIDIA BlueField-3), reporting up to 1.55x speedup on host-dominated workloads and quantifying architectural limits such as DRAM traffic overhead.

results.title: An RDMA-First Object Storage System with SmartNIC Offload
results.summary: Paper offloading the DAOS DFS client to an NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU, removing host mediation from the data path via RDMA to preserve inline storage performance comparable to the host for LLM training workloads.

results.title: Network-Offloaded Bandwidth-Optimal Broadcast and Allgather for Distributed AI
results.summary: Paper offloading the collective progress engine for broadcast/allgather to the SmartNIC Data Path Accelerator (DPA) with hardware multicast, achieving bandwidth-optimal, 2x traffic reduction on a 188-node testbed for FSDP training.

results.title: Demystifying Datapath Accelerator Enhanced Off-path SmartNIC
results.summary: Paper characterizing the BlueField-3 Data Path Accelerator (DPA) versus the off-path Arm cores and host CPU, identifying the DPA's unique inline networking/memory characteristics and achieving up to 4.3x higher throughput in key-value aggregation.

results.title: Intel's E2200 "Mount Morgan" IPU at Hot Chips 2025
results.summary: Detailed practitioner analysis of the Intel IPU E2200 inline dataplane, covering its P4-based packet pipeline, RDMA transport engine (Falcon/Swift, 2M queue pairs) and inline crypto block performing IPsec/PSP termination at 400 Gbps line rate.

results.title: AMD Pensando DPU Technology
results.summary: Official AMD product page for the Pensando DPU family (Salina/Sophia), describing the fully programmable P4 Match Processing Units that perform inline dataplane offload of network, storage, and security functions for AI workloads.
